'''Doc Aloor''' was a house located in the settlement [[Dalia (township)|Dalia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalicron-4]], which was used by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Aloor]] as both his office and his personal residence. Two rooms inside the building were set aside for use by Aloor's patients, in case he needed to monitor someone closely while they healed.
